_comment: Source of truth for OFFICIAL plugin packs. The release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) reads this: it builds+uploads a pack ONLY when its `version` differs from the previous release's manifest (otherwise it carries the already-built zip forward), and attaches this manifest to every release so the app can show the available version. Plugin versions are INDEPENDENT of the app version. Bump `version` here (and the plugin's own IPlugin.Version + csproj <Version>) when a pack changes. `asset` is the install contract with PluginInstallService.Catalog — do not rename without updating both.

plugins.name: Content Veil AI
plugins.description: deepghs anime censor-point detector (nano ONNX, MIT) — explicit-only image review for the content veil.
